# Video Controls Plus Docs

> Control your online video player the way you want it, and get special features on each website.

## Docs

- [What Video Controls Plus is](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/intro): Video Controls Plus is a browser extension that adds playback controls to HTML5 video on any site, with extra tools on YouTube, Netflix and LinkedIn.
- [Install Video Controls Plus](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/getting-started/install): Add Video Controls Plus from the Chrome Web Store, Microsoft Edge Add-ons or Firefox Add-ons, and speed control works as soon as it is installed.
- [Your first video with Video Controls Plus](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/getting-started/first-run): Open a video, change the speed with the bracket keys, find the widget and the popup, and see which controls need a connected account.
- [Pause the extension on one site](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/getting-started/pause-per-site): Pause Video Controls Plus on a single site from the popup, for 1 hour, 4 hours, 1 day, 1 week, or until you turn it back on.
- [Control the playback speed](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/speed-control): Change video speed in 0.1x steps with the bracket keys or the widget slider up to 4x, type a custom speed up to 16x, and use 8 preset speeds.
- [Loop a part of a video with an A-B loop](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/ab-loop): Set point A and point B and the video replays the stretch between them, forever, once, or 1 to 20 times; the A-B loop needs an account.
- [Boost the audio past 100%](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/audio-boost): Raise a video's volume up to 400% and switch on normalize to even out loud and quiet parts; audio boost needs an account.
- [Adjust the picture with video filters](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/video-filters): With a connected account, set brightness, contrast and saturation from 0% to 200%, use grayscale, invert or night mode, and save up to 20 presets.
- [Take a screenshot of a video frame](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/screenshots): Press Ctrl + Alt + C to save the current video frame as PNG or JPEG, download it or copy it, with an optional timestamp; it needs an account.
- [Take notes and add bookmarks while you watch](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/notes-and-bookmarks): Save notes with the video timestamp from the widget's Tools tab, export them as Markdown, text or JSON, and add a bookmark at the current moment.
- [Watch in Picture-in-Picture](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/picture-in-picture): Press Ctrl + Alt + P to put the video in a Picture-in-Picture window, or let it enter on its own when you scroll away; it works without an account.
- [Skip intros, recaps and credits automatically](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/auto-skip): Auto-skip clicks the skip buttons that Netflix, Prime Video and YouTube show; it is off by default and needs an account.
- [Choose how the controls appear on the page](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/user-guide/display-and-widget): Pick the floating widget or notification only, set the widget's position, size and how it opens, and choose a theme and a language.
- [Default keyboard shortcuts](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/keyboard-shortcuts/defaults): Every default key in Video Controls Plus: letter and digit keys need Ctrl + Alt, and only the bracket, punctuation and Esc keys work alone.
- [Change a keyboard shortcut](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/keyboard-shortcuts/rebinding): Give any shortcut another key in Settings, switch shortcuts off one by one or by section, and keep your keys across devices with a connected account.
- [Video Controls Plus on YouTube](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/platforms/youtube): On YouTube the core controls work as on any site, and each of the YouTube extras has its own switch in Settings; most are on by default.
- [Video Controls Plus on Netflix](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/platforms/netflix): Speed and the core controls work on Netflix; the Netflix extras are off until you switch them on, and recovery keys take over in one case.
- [Video Controls Plus on LinkedIn](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/platforms/linkedin): On LinkedIn the core video controls work, and a set of LinkedIn tools run from the widget or the right-click menu; switches are in Settings.
- [Which sites Video Controls Plus works on](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/platforms/other-sites): Video Controls Plus works on any site that plays a standard HTML5 video, including embedded players, with extra tools on YouTube, Netflix and LinkedIn.
- [AI features and what they send](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/ai-features): Video summaries and LinkedIn writing help run through a daily allowance, your own OpenAI or Anthropic key, or a local model; here is what each one sends.
- [Account, sync, export and delete](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/account-and-sync): How to connect Video Controls Plus to your account on the website, what connecting adds, how sync works, and how to export or delete your data.
- [Privacy and permissions](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/privacy-and-permissions): What Video Controls Plus stores and records, with and without an account, where the data lives, and what each browser permission is used for.
- [When Video Controls Plus is not working on a site](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/troubleshooting): What to check when Video Controls Plus does not appear on a site, a key does nothing, connecting fails, or a setting has no effect.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/faq): Short answers about speed, A-B loop, audio boost, screenshots, filters, shortcuts, supported sites, Netflix, privacy and deleting your data.
- [About Video Controls Plus](https://vcpeai-docs.aoneahsan.com/docs/about): Video Controls Plus is a browser extension for HTML5 video, built and maintained by the Video Controls Plus team.
